scope: Place names that start with an article («Los Almendros», «La Esperanza», «El Recreo») lost the article when noted as a delivery reference, and «en <place>» was noted with the preposition
trigger: Investigating the batch-92 gap about two-word places quoted as addresses
baselineFindings: Real router, synthetic menu, agent on and off: «domicilio» → «Los Almendros» → «Anoté la referencia: _Almendros_»; «El Prado» → «Prado»; «La Esperanza» → «Esperanza»
«en Villa Clara» was noted and stored as «en Villa Clara»
«Me lo envias a La Esperanza» named and stored «Esperanza» (the destination regex consumed «a la» / «para el»)
Not a defect: «San Telmo», «Santa Inés» and «barrio X» match the existing landmark keywords on purpose and are quoted like a neighborhood
fix: normalizeDeliveryAddress drops a leading «la/el/los/las» only before a generic address noun (calle, carrera, conjunto, barrio, casa, torre, edificio, misma, que, de…) or a number; any other following word is a place name and keeps it; a leading «a»/«al» is still removed. The «Anoté la referencia» path and the checkout switch to delivery use the same cleanup (preposition removed, article kept), and the destination regex now consumes only the preposition.

menus: seafood (spice option, two units, diagonal with tower)
contrasts: an article before a street is still dropped
«me lo envías a la <street>» quotes the street without the article
«al conjunto <name>» keeps the complex and drops the contraction
